narrative.details:
As a rogue of the Shattered Hand, it is imperative that you learn the Shattered Salute. It is the only way to truly identify another member of the Hand.

Watch, learn, repeat.
narrative.objectives: Perform the Shattered Salute on Shenthul.
narrative.offerRewardText: Well done, adventurer. You are now ready to proceed.
